properties.biography: Christopher Smith Jr., known professionally as Smino, was born on October 2, 1991, in St. Louis, Missouri, into a musical family — his father played keys, his mother sang, and his grandfather was a noted blues bassist. After releasing early mixtapes and moving to Chicago to attend Columbia College, he linked with engineer/manager Chris “Classik” Inumerable and co-founded the Zero Fatigue collective with Bari, Monte Booker, Jay2 and Ravyn Lenae. Smino released his first solo mixtape in 2012 and built critical momentum with EPs in 2015 before issuing his acclaimed debut album blkswn in 2017. He followed with NØIR (2018) and Luv 4 Rent (2022), growing a reputation for genre-blending production, nimble sing-rap flows, and charismatic live shows.
